This '''Rebel pilot''' was stationed at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] base on [[Kulthis]] during an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack on the [[Belderone system/Legends|Belderone system]]. The pilot was one of the reinforcements led by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in an attack against a contingent of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] on [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]]. He recalled Skywalker had fought walkers on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], and was taught how to use tow cables to bring them down.
